correctness.rationale: For unweighted real ℓ1 edge space of C_n □ K_2, n>=10, the n square circulations s_i and a global rim cycle t span the full n+1-dimensional kernel of the incidence map. Averaging an arbitrary projection under dihedral rotation/reflection and layer swap preserves the norm and projection property, allowing arrays b_i=-b_{-i-1}, 2a_i=1_{i=0}+b_i-b_{i-1}. Expanding all edge columns gives H=2Σ max(|a_i|,1/(2n))+Σ|a_i-a_{i-1}| and V=2Σ|b_i|+Σ|b_i-b_{i-1}|. The ten non-overlapping indices exist for n>=10 and produce 4H+V>=12-16/n, yielding the universal lower bound 12/5-16/(5n). Explicit b with u=(3n-9)/(10n), v=1/n attains H=V and fixes s_i,t.
